howToPlay: Switch between Work Mode to boost speed and Party Mode to heal teammates. Use the Weekend Warrior gadget to increase your damage output or Time For A Slow Song to control enemy movement. Balance your support utility with aggressive positioning to maximize your impact.
gears: Equip SPEED and HEALTH to capitalize on your mobility and survivability. DAMAGE or GADGET COOLDOWN are also excellent choices to enhance your offensive presence and utility.
trait: This brawler suits a tactical player who enjoys adapting to the flow of battle by alternating between offensive support and team healing.
